bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 June 2016'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2016.pdf) is a native digital PDF, but pdftotext -layout's initial extraction dropped/misaligned the same deep P&L rows as the 2016_Q1 filing (Total provisions, Contribution to NCC Bank Foundation, Profit before tax, Provision for tax, Profit after tax for the current-year column). Figures below were confirmed via a 300dpi visual render of the same source page, fully internally consistent: Profit before provisions 1,980,612,312 - Total provisions 725,132,557 = Profit after provision 1,255,479,755; less Contribution to NCC Bank Foundation 10,000,000 = Profit before tax 1,245,479,755; less Provision for tax 697,437,300 (current tax 707,976,929 + deferred tax income 10,539,629) = Profit after tax 548,042,455, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.62. Balance sheet was extracted cleanly and ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 141,608,588,799 + Total Shareholders' Equity 15,014,665,762 = Total Assets 156,623,254,561). Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2015' column (Total Assets BDT 146,369.95mn, Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 15,654.64mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2015_Q4.json exactly.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF page 8 (Balance Sheet, 'As at 30 June 2016') and page 9 (Profit and Loss Account, 'For the half year/2nd quarter ended on 30 June 2016'). pdftotext -layout lines 306-370 and 397-460 (with several P&L values re-verified via a 300dpi page render due to column-alignment extraction defects on that specific page).
